baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural faces are outward fronts, while the prepositional construction places ghbarah as a layer upon them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The face is both the observable human surface and a metonym for the person. Dust-colored or grief-darkened matter laid over that surface converts an inward condition into a publicly legible complexion without ceasing to be a bodily image.

activation_trace.role: The outward face or front supplies the observable surface on which the clause places a covering.
Face standing for the person lets the visible facial condition disclose the self while retaining its bodily anchor.
Dust, earth color, and grief-darkening supply both the literal coating and its affective visibility.

changed_reading.before: Some faces simply have dust on them.
changed_reading.after: Persons are exposed through their outward fronts, where a superimposed earth-colored or grief-darkened layer makes their condition visible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ghbarah occurs on faces on a specified Day, allowing the coating to be read temporally as well as materially.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root can image a remainder left after its companions have passed and can also image passing itself. On the face, the dust therefore works as adhered aftermath: the event has moved on, but its remainder has not.

activation_trace.role: The exposed front gives the remainder a place where it can persist and be seen.
A residue remaining after what accompanied it has gone supplies the temporal aftertrace carried by the face.
Passing and expiry supply the completed movement against which the still-present residue becomes conspicuous.

changed_reading.before: The dust is a present visual stain.
changed_reading.after: The dust is also an afterimage: what happened has passed, while its remainder stays attached to the exposed person.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wujuh can activate direction and the sound course of an affair, while ghbarah is explicitly positioned over it.
baseline_models.mechanism: If face is allowed to retain its directional force, the overlay does more than discolor a body. It occludes orientation and the prospect of a sound course; the person has a front but no clear way through the lasting opacity.

activation_trace.role: Direction and destination turn the face from anatomy alone into an oriented front.
The proper aspect or course of an affair supplies the possibility that what is obscured is also a way forward.
A dark calamity with no evident exit supplies the opaque obstruction laid across that orientation.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a dirty face.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also stage an oriented self whose front and proper course have been occluded by a lasting, hard-to-escape aftermath.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural wujuh permits a secondary activation of prominent social faces, all equally bearing ghbarah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Face can denote rank and a community's leading figures. A common dust-colored residue laid upon such faces converts distinction into exposure and levels eminence under the same material sign.

activation_trace.role: Social eminence and leading figures supply the status-bearing sense latent in the plural faces.
A shared dust-colored coating supplies the material equalizer that overrides visible prestige.
Lingering residue makes the loss of distinction persist rather than appear as a momentary smudge.

changed_reading.after: Even status-bearing public faces are leveled by one persistent coating, so social visibility becomes liability rather than protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening joins a contracted face to withdrawal. That sequence activates the focus face as an oriented, responsive surface and ghbarah as the residue of a history of turning, rather than as an arbitrary final cosmetic mark.

activation_trace.role: A face contracted by distress or anger supplies the first visible deformation and makes facial state narratively consequential.
Withdrawal and turning away supply the directional act whose history can later be carried by the face.
Orientation and facing let the final face answer the earlier directional withdrawal.
Remaining residue turns the earlier act into an adhered aftereffect rather than an isolated expression.

structural_cues: The surah opens with facial contraction plus directional withdrawal and returns near its close to plural faces bearing a residue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contraction, withdrawal, orientation, and later residue; I supply the arrow that enacted orientation leaves a visible history. A live alternative is that the opening and final facial states are parallel but causally unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The final dust is an externally assigned sign.
changed_reading.after: The final face can be the accumulated visible history of how one faced or turned from another, with residue preserving the act after it passed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first marks a person by loss of sight, later commands directed looking, and supplies a branch in which looking alters visible color or defect. The focus reverses visual agency: the decisive subjects are now exposed as faces whose own discoloration is available to inspection.

activation_trace.role: Loss of bodily sight supplies the initial visual classification that the final exposed faces can reverse.
Directed sight or insight supplies an active observer and makes the later facial surface something to be recognized.
A gaze-associated effect in color or defect supplies a lexical bridge from seeing to altered complexion.
The outward face becomes the object presented to the observer rather than the organ that controls observation.
Dust- or grief-darkened color makes the person's condition visually unavoidable.

structural_cues: A person is initially identified through blindness, an imperative to look appears later, and the close displays contrasting faces to view.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight loss, directed looking, altered color, and displayed faces; I infer a reversal from classifying another by sight to being made visibly classifiable oneself. The alternative is a non-thematic recurrence of visual vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The dust merely reports the bearers' misfortune.
changed_reading.after: The dusty faces enact a reversal of visual power: those faces cannot manage the encounter by looking away because their own exposed surfaces now disclose them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated images of purification make the focus residue contrastive. Ghbarah is no longer generic dirt alone; it is what remains uncleared on the person when cleansing, repair, or moral growth is the live alternative.

activation_trace.role: Purity and soundness supply an early possible removal of stain against which later residue stands out.
Clearness through disappearance of impurity supplies the exact counter-process to a layer that remains.
The leftover remainder supplies what the context's cleansing processes have not removed.
The visible dusty discoloration materializes that uncleared remainder on the face.

structural_cues: Purification appears as a possible human change and as a quality of the elevated sheets before the final unremoved coating appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cleansing branches and a remaining dusty layer; I infer contrast rather than a stated failed washing. The live alternative is that purity belongs only to separate actors or objects and does not condition the focus image.

changed_reading.before: The coating is simply present dirt.
changed_reading.after: The coating is the conspicuous remainder that persists in a discourse where becoming clean and having impurity removed were real possibilities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early self-sufficient figure attracts attention, but later each person has an affair sufficient to absorb him. This activates the social-rank branch of wujuh: public faces and notables lose the attention economy that sustained distinction and bear the same residue as everyone else.

activation_trace.role: Self-sufficiency supplies the socially privileged posture around which attention is initially organized.
Sufficiency as complete preoccupation redistributes attention so that no public standing can command another's care.
Each person's own affair or condition supplies the isolating burden that collapses shared status relations.
Eminence and leading social faces supply the rank that the closing scene can level.
A common earth-colored coating visibly overrides the differentiating signs of prestige.

structural_cues: The opening allocates attention according to apparent self-sufficiency; immediately before the face sequence, each individual is enclosed by his own affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-sufficiency, isolating sufficiency, personal affairs, and face-as-rank; I infer that the final coating levels the former attention hierarchy. The alternative is that wujuh remains exclusively anatomical.

changed_reading.before: Dust marks unfortunate individuals without a social dimension.
changed_reading.after: The dust also strips public faces of the prestige that once organized attention, exposing rank as unable to survive the final isolation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of written sheets and a branch where a book discloses writing activates a surface analogy. The focus face becomes an involuntary counter-document: residue on the body's front records the person as visibly as writing occupies a sheet.

activation_trace.role: A written sheet supplies the deliberate inscribed surface against which the later bodily surface can be compared.
A book that reveals what is written supplies disclosure rather than mere storage as the document's function.
The outward front supplies a bodily surface available for involuntary display.
Face-for-self makes what appears on that surface readable as evidence about the whole person.
Persistent residue functions as the mark that remains legible after the producing events have passed.

structural_cues: The middle sequence moves through sheets and their carriers; the closing sequence shifts disclosure onto human faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written disclosure, an outward bodily front, and persistent residue; I supply the cross-domain analogy that the face acts as a record surface. The live alternative is ordinary facial expression with no documentary force.

changed_reading.before: The face merely exhibits a mood or physical condition.
changed_reading.after: The face operates like an involuntary exposed record, with residue serving as a durable mark that the bearer cannot edit or conceal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Loss of life, concealment in burial, and revival form a passage through disappearance and reopening. Against that sequence, the focus's residue branch becomes decisive: the restored face is not reset to an unmarked surface but returns bearing what survived the passage.

activation_trace.role: Departure of life and power supplies the first disappearance through which the person passes.
Burial and concealment supply a material interval in which the visible face is hidden.
Revival after death supplies the return of the person and therefore of a face that can be seen again.
Face-for-person locates continuity of identity across disappearance and restoration.
A remainder surviving after companions pass supplies continuity of trace across the life-death-return sequence.
Passing away supplies the temporal transition that the visible remainder outlasts.

structural_cues: A tightly ordered sequence moves through death, burial, and revival before the Day's faces are displayed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disappearance, concealment, restoration, and a surviving remainder; I infer that restoration preserves rather than erases trace. A materially live alternative is simpler grave dust adhering after emergence.

changed_reading.before: The revived bearers happen to appear dusty.
changed_reading.after: Their reappearing faces demonstrate continuity through death: restoration exposes a residue that passage and burial did not erase.

context_deltas.mechanism: A water-like sheen, unveiled brightness, visible gleam, and open good appearance establish the face as a light-bearing surface. Ghbarah then reads not merely as dirt but as opacity: particulate, earth-colored matter suppresses reflection and closes what the preceding faces reveal.

activation_trace.role: Water-like sheen specifically available in a face supplies a hydrated, reflective counter-surface to dust.
Unveiled brightness of light or face supplies the immediately preceding luminous state.
A visible gleam likened to laughter intensifies the optical quality of the contrasting faces.
An open face and fair outward appearance supply the unobstructed human surface opposite the focus coating.
The face as outward front is the stable surface across the bright and dusted alternatives.
Earth-colored and grief-darkened dust supplies an optically dull layer that suppresses the established sheen.

structural_cues: After the water and growth sequence, the close places unveiled, gleaming faces directly before faces bearing an overlaid dusty color.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facial sheen, unveiled brightness, gleam, openness, and dust-darkening; I infer a material transition from reflectivity to opacity. The alternative is a purely affective contrast of happiness and distress.

changed_reading.before: Dust is one conventional sign of sadness.
changed_reading.after: Dust is an optical-material foreclosure: a once light-bearing human surface has become dull, opaque, and unable to disclose brightness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence turns covering into reciprocal action. Those named through covering and through breach of a veil are first shown with an overlaid residue, then actively overtaken by facial darkness; agency reverses as the coverers become the covered.

activation_trace.role: Covering as a concrete action supplies the reversible operation enacted upon the faces.
Concealment of truth supplies the agential form of covering that the visible facial covering answers.
An overlying force that reaches and overpowers supplies active escalation beyond the focus's static layer.
Darkening located on the face supplies a second, more enclosing facial state.
Deviation through breaching a protective veil supplies the complementary action of violating a boundary.
The exposed front is the site where the reversal of covering becomes public.
A dark calamity with lasting effect turns the coating into an enclosing condition rather than loose debris.

structural_cues: The focus first states a layer upon faces; the next ayah gives covering an active verb; the last ayah names the bearers through roots of covering and veil-breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concrete covering, concealment, active overtake, facial darkness, and veil-breach; I infer reciprocal reversal between what the bearers do and what overtakes them. The alternative is that signs and labels accumulate without mirroring agency.

changed_reading.before: Dust and darkness are external labels attached to a condemned group.
changed_reading.after: The sequence materializes a reversal: covering returns upon its agents, progressively occupying the very faces through which they would meet the event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 80:40 contains no motion verb and ghbarah most directly names a facial coating. It remains anchored because the focus root itself includes hard pursuit and dust-raising, while the context opposes purposeful striving to frantic flight. Downstream prose should present it only as a possible kinetic echo, not as a replacement for visible dust or residue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ghbarah is on the forward-facing surface, and one focus branch explicitly joins pressing pursuit with raised dust.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful movement toward a desired end supplies one morally and directionally coherent way of raising dust.
Flight supplies the reversed, disintegrating movement whose turbulence can leave a different dust trace.
Pressing pursuit and dust-raising supply the direct kinetic bridge from movement to the facial deposit.
Facing an encounter supplies the forward surface on which the wake of pursuit or flight becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: The dust is immobile grime unrelated to prior movement.
changed_reading.after: The dust may preserve a kinetic history, contrasting directed striving with desperate flight and marking where that trajectory ended.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the noun in the focus ordinarily presents dust, not a wound. It remains valid as a latent analogy because the focus inventory itself includes a badly closed wound that breaks open again, and the context repeatedly opens what was closed through revival, splitting, and rupture. Downstream prose should call it a recurrent-wound model and retain the literal dust reading beside it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ghbarah root supplies recurrence after apparent closure, while the face-for-self branch locates the renewed trace on the restored person.

activation_trace.role: A wound flaring after seeming to settle supplies the recurrent rather than merely residual mechanism.
Face standing for the self makes the reopened trace a condition of the restored person, not free-floating imagery.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the first context mechanism by which settled closure is undone.
Splitting and opening supply a material recurrence of rupture after a closed surface.
Broad rupture and outflow carry the reopening mechanism into the final identification of the bearers.

changed_reading.before: The face bears the passive remainder of a finished event.
changed_reading.after: The face may bear an old corruption becoming active again: restoration reopens rather than heals what only appeared settled.

strongest_changes: Ghbarah shifted from loose dust to a residue that survives passage, burial, and reopening.
The opening facial turn and the closing covering sequence made the face an exposed record of orientation and reversal.
Water-like sheen and the immediately bright faces sharpened the focus coating as opacity replacing luminosity.
The covering root reversed agency: those associated with covering are themselves progressively covered.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained simultaneously bodily, temporal, directional, social, documentary, optical, and material. The most productive surprise was that ghbarah could preserve an event after it passed, while the strongest contextual revision turned a static dusty face into the endpoint of enacted orientation and reciprocal covering.
remaining_uncertainties: The residue and recurrent-wound branches may function only as latent mechanisms rather than active senses of the focus noun.
Face-as-document and face-as-status remain coherent secondary models but are less form-near than the bodily surface reading.
The kinetic model explains raised dust but not necessarily why it settles specifically on faces, so it must remain exploratory.
